verdict.rationale: Brex's own Bill Pay pages cover all three parts of the story. AI captures itemized details and drafts payments, multi-level approval flows route automatically by amount, vendor and role, and vendors can be paid by ACH, check or wire, which the Payments API documentation backs up. All of this comes from first-party marketing and API docs only; missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP workflow, detailed documentation of invoice intake channels and capture accuracy.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire

citations.quote: Brex AI will capture every itemized detail, suggest the matching PO, and draft a payment.
Tailor multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, employee role, and more — and Brex will route for you automatically to ensure the right people sign off every time.
Send ACH, checks, and wires from any bank account or a Brex business account for even faster payments in more currencies.
Payments API: Manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks
